purpose: Legacy public-source comparison evidence only. It does not bind Robinhood deployment, launch, admission, routing, provider, bridge, message, or API behavior.

entries.reusableInterfaceShape: A sequential vault state machine can make funding, outbound execution, return attribution, and payout commitment explicit and single-use.
A narrow outbound adapter surface can bind a cycle, amount, recipient representation, and bounded fee before external movement.
A narrow return finalizer can require one-time receipt handling and exact local credit attribution.
A committed root and cumulative payment domain can isolate funded holder distributions from route execution.
A graph authorization can bind a deterministic component set, commitment, predicted targets, and one consumed authorization key.
A local harness can test deterministic graph commitment and consumed-authorization behavior without treating deployment mechanics as production truth.
An initializer can validate a complete component composition and bind one launch receipt before activation.
A factory comparison can inform deterministic hook-construction tests, subject to current Robinhood admission evidence.
A fee-hook comparison can inform exact liability-isolation and callback-authentication test shapes without importing fee or provider semantics.
A documented direct graph supplies vocabulary for component-composition review only.
A provider handoff supplies a checklist shape for later independent Robinhood evidence collection only.
